input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text or /moves/knight_g8.text must also be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and any commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num in the same commit.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_f8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false))
